fusions.name: Kneading Claws
fusions.desc: A quick claw-tipped swat that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Knocked Off the Shelf
fusions.desc: Bats the target away with the flat of a paw for 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Second-Storey Work
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: By the Fingernails
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
